name: A Husband's Last Battle

faq.answer: Dreka'Sur is an orc stationed at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood who seeks the death of Overlord Ror.
Bloodvenom Post is a Horde encampment established in the corrupted forest of Felwood.
Overlord Ror is a menacing creature whose claw Dreka'Sur demands as proof of his demise.

sections.body: In the poisoned woods of Felwood, Dreka'Sur waits at Bloodvenom Post for vengeance. She calls on you to hunt down Overlord Ror and return with his severed claw as proof of the deed.
sections.title: Blood and Claw

summary: At Bloodvenom Post in Felwood, Dreka'Sur seeks vengeance against Overlord Ror. She asks you to bring down the brute and return his severed claw to the outpost.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Husband's Last Battle
